Bhavna Gupta | bhavna.gupta14@example.com | +91 9219323935
Kolkata
Notice period: 90 days

Professional Summary
Result-oriented Azure-focused DevOps engineer with strong experience designing and operating cloud-native CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and container orchestration for enterprise applications. Proven track record delivering repeatable automation, improving deployment frequency, and reducing rollback incidents through robust testing and monitoring practices.

Technical Skills
Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, Docker, Bicep, Linux, Confluence, Git

Work Experience

Senior Azure DevOps Engineer, NimbusSoft (Apr 2016 - Present)
- Designed and implemented Azure-based multi-environment CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps integrating Git-based source control and automated releases, reducing manual deployment steps by 70% using Azure and Azure DevOps.
- Containerized microservices with Docker and deployed to Kubernetes clusters on Azure, improving scalability and decreasing average service startup time; coordinated image build pipelines and lifecycle management with Git and Azure DevOps.
- Managed infrastructure as code using Terraform for network, storage, and compute provisioning in Azure and authored Bicep modules for standardized resource templates; automated environment provisioning to support on-demand test clusters.
- Maintained Linux-based build and deployment agents, documented runbooks and design decisions in Confluence, and enforced Git branching strategies to streamline collaboration and change tracking.

Cloud Engineer, Wipro (Dec 2015 - Mar 2016)
- Implemented Azure DevOps build and release pipelines to migrate legacy deployments to automated flows, integrating Docker image builds and registry management to standardize artifacts.
- Wrote Terraform modules to provision Azure resources and collaborated on Kubernetes cluster setup for container orchestration; improved cluster provisioning time and repeatability.
- Supported Linux-based CI agents and used Git for source control; documented deployment procedures in Confluence to reduce onboarding time for new team members.

Azure DevOps Engineer, Infosys (Dec 2014 - Nov 2015)
- Developed infrastructure templates using Bicep and supported Kubernetes-based deployments for development and staging environments; automated deployments via Azure DevOps pipelines tied to Git repositories.
- Built Docker images and maintained container registries, validated container security and runtime behavior on Linux hosts, and authored documentation in Confluence for operational handover.

Education
B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore
